shortDescription: Information module for Icap Spectrum Sensor Reports

options.name: apMac
options.description: ApMac query parameter. The base ethernet macAddress of the access point.

options.name: dataType
options.description: DataType query parameter. Data type reported by the sensor |Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | | `0` | Duty Cycle | | `1` | Max Power | | `2` | Average Power | | `3` | Max Power in dBm with adjusted base of +48 | | `4` | Average Power in dBm with adjusted base of +48 |.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. End time to which API queries the data set related to the resource. It must be specified in UNIX epochtime in milliseconds. Value is inclusive.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Maximum number of records to return.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Specifies the starting point within all records returned by the API. It's one based offset. The starting value is 1.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. Start time from which API queries the data set related to the resource. It must be specified in UNIX epochtime in milliseconds. Value is inclusive.

options.name: timeSortOrder
options.description: TimeSortOrder query parameter. The sort order of the field ascending or descending.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
